finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D3 integrated composition, 2-3 layers, moderate detail. Scene: Simple sunny garden corner with a low TWO-panel wooden rail fence turning gently into distance, ochre posts with realistic connected rails and ground contact. A yellow-olive shrub partly overlaps fence at lower left, a pale gray-green lawn behind, small pale-cyan sky patch. Beige bare ground in foreground, sparse olive grass dabs. Three readable depth layers. No house, gate hardware, flowers or fine wood grain. Square marker illustration, moderate detail. Palette: 67 pale cyan; 172 extremely pale gray-green; 44 yellow olive; 41 dark olive; 95 ochre brown; 25 very pale gray-beige. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.

Panel instructions: 1 定位三层与焦点 — Pencil outline only, no final colors. 铅笔: 画幅约12厘米，先标近处灌木、中间栅栏、远处草地三层；栅栏最高处不过画面上三分之二。 Check: 主体是栅栏与灌木，不让远树抢焦点。 2 校正柱与横杆 — Pencil outline only, no final colors. 铅笔: 标两根主柱的上、下端，再画两条横杆；每根杆必须接到柱上，远端略短、略窄，不凭空结束在草里。 Check: 杆与柱连接明确，柱底在同一坡面。 4 铺远天空和草地 — Cumulative state AFTER operation 4, earlier marks preserved, later-operation colors and marks absent. 67、172: 67只铺上方小片天空，云留纸白；172铺远草地，栅栏与灌木区域暂不涂。 Check: 远景比近景轻，天空不压满整张纸。 5 搭远树浅色 — Cumulative state AFTER operation 5, earlier marks preserved, later-operation colors and marks absent. 44: 用少量大短触概括远树和低灌木，边缘软而不碎；近灌木只先铺浅形，不急着每叶加深。 Check: 远树笔触比近叶更少、更小。.
